TITLE: Chat
REPEATS_TIP: The same player's same words one after another show once, with ×N.
KEPT_TIP: The last lines of each tab come back after a reload, dimmed. 0: none.
HELD_TIP: Older lines go once a tab holds this many.
INPUT_ALWAYS_TIP: Off, the input shows from Enter until the line is sent.
KEYWORDS_TIP: Someone else's line with one of these words, or with your name, is marked.
HISTORY_TIP: What Alt+Up and Alt+Down bring back of what you sent.
HIDE_TIP: The chat shows while the cursor is on it or while you type, and hides when the cursor leaves.
HIDDEN_OPACITY_TIP: How much of the chat shows while it is hidden. 0%: none.
TAB_COUNTER_TIP: The number of lines that came while another tab was open, on the tab.
TAB_CHANNEL_NAMES_TIP: How a channel's lines name their channel in this tab.
